samplingRule: Sort canonical arXiv IDs ascending; random.Random(seed).sample(population, devSize+testSize); first devSize to dev, remaining to sealed test. No resampling based on labels, predictions or availability.
titleNormalization: Unicode NFKC, HTML entity unescape, casefold, collapse whitespace, strip final full stop. Exact equality only; quarantine does not assert authority identity.
amendmentReason: Metadata-only title screening found 18 residual historical-title matches after canonical exclusion; initial selected 40 had none. Preserve initial draw and quarantine matches before a new explicitly versioned draw. No labels, abstracts or predictions were viewed.
scope: Finite cs.AI February 2025 listing snapshot after canonical exposure exclusion and conservative exact-title quarantine. Not all arXiv, all AI or all DBLP; metadata isolation is not semantic independence proof.
